Welcome to Local AI Proxy

LocalAIProxy turns the AI CLIs installed on this machine into a local OpenAI-compatible API.

  1. 1Start the local server
  2. 2Copy the API URL
  3. 3Use a model from the Dashboard as model — the defaults are claude, codex, gemini, opencode

Everything stays on this machine. LocalAIProxy never manages your provider logins.

Add model

What clients send as model. Letters, digits, . _ : -.

"Disabled" models answer in one JSON response and refuse stream:true with streaming_not_supported rather than fake-token near-real-time output.

Enabled Disabled models disappear from /v1/models and refuse requests.

Delete model?

This model profile will be removed. Requests using it will fail until you add it again.

Requests still running

One or more AI requests are still in progress. Closing now will cancel them.
